fusions.name: Tracker Dart
fusions.desc: Fires a homing tracker dart that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Jaws
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A spring-jaw strike that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Target Scope
fusions.desc: Snaps a ranging scope over your eye that raises your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Pursuit Algorithm
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
